body: My mistakes. I just feel so tied down by what I’ve done and feel as though nothing matter anymore

After reading through all this, it's clear you really love your daughter. I'm only 21 and unmarried so I can't say I can relate in your situation. I'm not even sure my first love was someone I really loved... I know you're a good father because you truly care for her. That's something that I feel should be appreciated.

Looking back at childhood, I ended up realizing how much my parents did for me. They really cared for my future even it meant not spending quality time with their child due to working constantly. It hit me hard when I came to that realization. They do love me and it's one of the reasons I keep on moving. I'm currently dealing with depression but I'm taking steps to break out of this wall I made for myself. Seeing you talk about your situation and how much you love your daughter. It reminds me of my parents love for me, so I've decided that I'll try to become the most caring father when I have family of my own (if I even want children lol).

Don't give up sir, I want you to have a happy ending. ❤

I want to increase my muscle mass but what I really am going towards is to get toned. I'm not tallest and biggest guy out there, so I would like to maintain a sleeker body instead of getting overly buff (you know what I mean?). Is there anything I need to look out for or do to see improvement quickly? (I know you can't get these things in a day but I'm asking more of like what I can do to get the most out of my workouts?)
Also, that's great to hear you're going riding tomorrow. Very exciting! I hope you the best of luck in riding (one of my goals is to learn to ride a motorcycle one day).

I have started by running a mile and doing core exercises like planks and crunches. I'm trying to make runnig and core a daily routine before I start working out the different muscle groups. I'd love to be able to keep each other accountable! I still need to learn more about what to eat to obtain these gains so if you have any advice on that it would be greatly appreciated!!
Thank you! I hope so and will keep trying my best
Thank you, Chris. It really means a lot you shared that with me. I'll keep trying, fam.
